# X API console

> A local browser console for the X API, also called the Twitter API v2. You run it on your own machine and call posts, users, direct messages, media, and streams with your own keys.

## Docs

- [X API console](https://ankshvayt.github.io/x-api-console/): What the tool is, how to run it, and where keys are stored.
- [README](https://github.com/ankshvayt/x-api-console#readme): Clone steps, credentials, Ask, and the localhost bridge.
- [Source](https://github.com/ankshvayt/x-api-console): The HTML page, start.js, and the MIT license.

## Key facts

- Not an official X or Twitter product.
- One HTML file plus a Node.js 18 bridge. No packages to install.
- Default address: http://127.0.0.1:8787
- X API keys stay in browser localStorage on that address.
- A saved TypeSafe key is written to .jev-key, which is gitignored.
- The bridge listens on 127.0.0.1 and only forwards to api.x.com, api.twitter.com, and upload.twitter.com.
- The route list matches the X API docs as of 28 September 2026. Custom request covers any other api.x.com path.
- License: MIT
